research_metadata.title: AI Workload-Driven Storage: 2025-01 to 2026-09 Update
research_metadata.scope: AI workloads driving storage requirements — 2025 Q1 through 2026 Q3 update over v1.0 (covers KV cache persistence, training checkpoints, RAG/vector DB, multimodal small-file IO, AI data lakes, burst IO/HPC, persistent memory, inference tail-latency jitter).
research_metadata.verification_method: Every entry below was verified against a real URL (arXiv/USENIX/MLSys/CVPR/OpenReview/GitHub releases/official news/blog). Where the parent task brief contained errors (date, version, paper ID), the actual verified fact is recorded and the discrepancy is flagged in 'brief_vs_actual'.
research_metadata.disclaimer: Many figures in the parent task brief were inaccurate (Mistral Magistral was 2025-Q2 not Q4; ROCm 7.0 was Sep-2025 not Q1-2025; Mooncake production metrics differ from cited; ICEBerg v1.5 was Mar-2024 not 2025-Q2; Mooncake GitHub org is now kvcache-ai; OpenSearch GPU-accelerated vector GA was 3.1.0 not 2.x). The corrected record is below.

Pluggable KV connector architecture (LMCache, Mooncake, NIXL, etc.)

AI-native memory paradigm.

1_llm_inference_kv_cache_persistence.name: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5 prompt cache (2025-09) + 5x cost reduction
1_llm_inference_kv_cache_persistence.description: Claude Sonnet 4.5 launched Sept 29, 2025 with prompt caching already GA since Aug 2024. Sonnet 4.5 pricing: $3/$15 per million input/output tokens; cache reads cost $0.30 per million (90% discount); cache writes cost $3.75 per million (25% premium over standard input). Cache TTL 5 min (default) or 1 hour; minimum 2048 tokens (Sonnet/Opus), 1024 tokens (Haiku).
1_llm_inference_kv_cache_persistence.cache_5x_cost_real_world: Per-pricing page, cache reads are 90% off base input price (= 10x cost reduction per token, not literally 5x). The '5x' in brief likely refers to overall TCO reduction observed by Anthropic customers combining caching + batching, or net cost-per-1M-tokens in typical multi-turn RAG workflows where cache hit rates exceed 80%.
1_llm_inference_kv_cache_persistence.cache_size_constraints: Up to 4 cache breakpoints per request; each breakpoint creates a new cache prefix. Sonnet 4.5 standard 200K context.
1_llm_inference_kv_cache_persistence.extended_thinking: Visible thinking mode + tool use; Computer use (Sep 2025).
1_llm_inference_kv_cache_persistence.brief_vs_actual: Brief said 'Sonnet 4.5 prompt cache 2025-09 + 5x cost reduction'. Verified: Sonnet 4.5 released Sep 29 2025; prompt caching GA; the discount is 90% (= 10x per-token, not 5x). The '5x' figure may refer to overall TCO including batching.
